CONSTANT Workers = { w1 , w2 }
INIT Init
NEXT Next
SYMMETRY Sym
INVARIANT SCDraw_Pool_Mark
CONSTRAINT SCDraw_Pool_Budget
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

wrapper.name: SCDraw_Pool
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Pool ----
EXTENDS Pool
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Pool_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Pool_Budget == SCDraw_Pool_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Pool_Broken == (IF NotAllBusy THEN {} ELSE {"NotAllBusy"})
SCDraw_Pool_Mark == IF SCDraw_Pool_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Pool_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<busy>>, SCDraw_Pool_Broken>>)
====
